second_pass.method: 先逐段检查外层表达动作及内部搭配，再回看所有未收段和已有条目所在段；补充否定推论、条件、转述、时间与普通动作结构，不按单词简单或考试出现推定掌握。
second_pass.intentionally_omitted: 称呼致谢、宗教祝福、政治运动口号、专名罗列、一次性长修辞、仅依赖具体历史的比喻；引用段可收可迁移局部但不冒充日常高频。

items.note: 不一定仅指结婚；原句与 met my wife 区分。
items.quote: I chose Chicago not only because it's my hometown, where I met my wife and we started a family, but also because it's really where my career in public service began.

items.meaning: 贯穿某事的持续线索或主题
items.note: 原句贯穿职业历程，不是软件线程。
items.quote: The running thread through my career has been the notion that when ordinary people get involved and get engaged and come together in collective effort, things change for the better.

items.note: 后可接 in；此处普通人的公共参与。
items.quote: The running thread through my career has been the notion that when ordinary people get involved and get engaged and come together in collective effort, things change for the better.

items.note: better 表结果方向，不只单纯变化。
items.quote: The running thread through my career has been the notion that when ordinary people get involved and get engaged and come together in collective effort, things change for the better.

items.meaning: 在某事的核心；是某事关键
items.quote: That's the belief at the heart of this precious American experiment in self-government.

items.meaning: 忽略或忘了某事的重要性
items.quote: It's easy to lose sight of that truth in the day-to-day back and forth of Washington or our minute-to-minute news cycles.

items.note: 原句名词化的政治日常往复，也可字面来回。
items.quote: It's easy to lose sight of that truth in the day-to-day back and forth of Washington or our minute-to-minute news cycles.

items.meaning: 放到更长的时间跨度来看
items.note: horizon 比喻观察或计划期限。
items.quote: But remember that America is a story told over a longer time horizon, in fits and starts, punctuated at times by hardship, but ultimately written by generations of citizens who've somehow worked together, without fanfare, to form a more perfect Union.

But remember that America is a story told over a longer time horizon, in fits and starts, punctuated at times by hardship, but ultimately written by generations of citizens who've somehow worked together, without fanfare, to form a more perfect Union.

items.note: 原句 by hardship，并非标点教学义。
items.quote: But remember that America is a story told over a longer time horizon, in fits and starts, punctuated at times by hardship, but ultimately written by generations of citizens who've somehow worked together, without fanfare, to form a more perfect Union.

items.meaning: 不事张扬地；没有大肆宣扬
items.quote: But remember that America is a story told over a longer time horizon, in fits and starts, punctuated at times by hardship, but ultimately written by generations of citizens who've somehow worked together, without fanfare, to form a more perfect Union.

items.meaning: 把某事转变成另一种状态
items.note: 原句从萎缩经济转为增长经济，保留转变方向。
items.quote: Together, we've turned an economy that was shrinking and losing jobs into one that's growing and creating jobs, with poverty falling, incomes rising, and wages that have jumped faster over the past few years than at any time in the past four decades.

items.chunk: faster than at any time in ...
items.note: 应有事实数据支持比较；不把演讲主张视为独立核证。
items.quote: Together, we've turned an economy that was shrinking and losing jobs into one that's growing and creating jobs, with poverty falling, incomes rising, and wages that have jumped faster over the past few years than at any time in the past four decades.

items.meaning: 事先已经存在的疾病／状况
items.note: 此处医疗保险语境，不将单词 preexisting 包装独立chunk。
items.quote: ending the days of discrimination against up to half of Americans who have a preexisting condition, and secured new rights and protections for everybody with health insurance.

items.note: 原句 off the battlefield for good，不是为了好处。
items.quote: Together, we've brought home most of our brave troops from Iraq and Afghanistan, took bin Laden and thousands of other terrorists off the battlefield for good.

items.chunk: open a new chapter with sb.
items.note: 原句外交关系，比日常 start again 更庄重。
items.quote: We've opened a new chapter with the people of Cuba, shut down Iran's nuclear weapons program without firing a single shot, and brought the world together around a climate agreement that could save this planet for future generations.

items.note: measures 此处标准或指标，不是行动措施。
items.quote: By these measures and many more, we have made America a better, stronger place for the generation that follows ours.

items.meaning: 完成自己负责的一段接力／路程
items.note: 原句 long journey，非所有项目默认套语。
items.quote: We've run our leg in a long journey of progress, knowing that our work is and will always be unfinished.

items.note: 原句邀请听告别演讲，不是调整乐器音准。
items.quote: That will be the focus of my Farewell to you this Tuesday, and I hope you'll tune in.

quote_recovery: 已确认候选的原例收为目标所在完整原句或必要连续片段；只回收原文子串，没有发现新项或改写。原精选精确引文保留。
